summary: Owner-attended phase-aware SN2400 RAM boot at the unchanged 300 mA USB input limit; positive idle cell-current means +38.72 mA over 25 samples and +54.31 mA over a later 13 samples. Thermal, USB and finite-lease monitoring remained active in these observations. Storage-load power margin, sustained charging and independent DMA retirement remain unqualified. All original measurements are preserved in docs/N71_SN2400_PHASE_BOOT_PHYSICAL_2026_11_24.json.
